question: Which district has more paved road per 1,000 residents in 2025, Coldharbour or Stonecairn, and by how many km per 1,000 residents?

samples.text:
Facts used:
- Coldharbour’s 2025 population was 11,407 residents (NR-12).
- Coldharbour has 598.3 km of paved roads (NR-12).
- Stonecairn’s 2025 population was 14,926 residents (NR-06).
- Stonecairn has 506.8 km of paved roads (NR-06).

Calculation:
- Coldharbour: \(598.3 \div 11,407 \times 1,000 = 52.448\) km per 1,000 residents.
- Stonecairn: \(506.8 \div 14,926 \times 1,000 = 33.957\) km per 1,000 residents.
- Difference: \(52.448 - 33.957 = 18.491\) km per 1,000 residents.

Coldharbour has more paved road per 1,000 residents, by 18.491 km per 1,000 residents.

ANSWER: Coldharbour | 18.491
